heading: A traveller’s guide under segregation
text: This 1941 guide helped Black travellers find services while segregation made parts of a journey unsafe. The public record includes the historical language of the title.
source: National Museum of African American History and Culture

heading: An object from a serious workplace injury
text: This is the iron associated with Phineas Gage’s injury in Vermont. The catalogue describes his accident and what happened to his remains. The game’s illustration shows the iron on its support.

heading: The Dhuwa petition about land at Yirrkala
text: Yolŋu leaders at Yirrkala called for an inquiry after land was set aside for mining without consultation. This is the parliamentary petition presented on 14 August 1963. Its painted border carries authority specific to its makers.

heading: The Yirritja petition about land at Yirrkala
text: This petition was presented on 28 August 1963. Its Yolŋu authors brought their law and their request concerning mining to Parliament on a painted bark. Reading the public petition gives a visitor one account of the dispute. Its designs belong to their own custodians.

heading: A war photograph from the Taku forts
text: Felice Beato’s photograph belongs to an album about the Second Opium War. Its title records a surrender and the taking of prisoners in 1860. The caption comes from the catalogue. It cannot tell us what the prisoners would have said.
